ActorFrame.UpdateSend1Command: %function(self) if GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_1) and GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_1) then MESSAGEMAN:Broadcast('UpdateP1') end end
ActorFrame.UpdateSend2Command: %function(self) if GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_2) and GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_2) then MESSAGEMAN:Broadcast('UpdateP2') end end
ActorFrame.UpdateThumbCommand: %function(self) if DWIGlobVar.YouShouldChangeThatShitNOW then return end DWIGlobVar.YouShouldChangeThatShitNOW=true self:queuecommand('Thumb') end
ActorFrame.ThumbCommand: %function(self) if DWIGlobVar.YouShouldChangeThatShitNOW then MESSAGEMAN:Broadcast('UpdateScrollThumb') self:sleep(0.01) self:queuecommand('UpdateThumb') end DWIGlobVar.YouShouldChangeThatShitNOW = false end

Layer.UpdateThumbCommand:
%function(self) local ScrollBarEle = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('MusicWheel'):GetChild('') local EndDelta = 0 local T1ZoomY = ScrollBarEle:GetChildAt(1):GetZoomY() local T2ZoomY = ScrollBarEle:GetChildAt(2):GetZoomY() local T1Y = ScrollBarEle:GetChildAt(1):GetY() local T2Y = ScrollBarEle:GetChildAt(2):GetY()
if T2ZoomY >= T1ZoomY+0.01 then if T2ZoomY > 0 then EndDelta = (T1ZoomY/2)*(T1ZoomY/T2ZoomY) end self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+T2Y+EndDelta) else if T2ZoomY > 0 then EndDelta = (T1ZoomY/2)*(T2ZoomY/T1ZoomY) end self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+T1Y-EndDelta) end end
